name: Realizable Ample Classes Are Not Closed Under Gated Common-Section Gluing
statement: Even when two realizable ample pieces are downward closed in their private coordinates and are gated induced subgraphs with a common gated coordinate section, their ample union need not be realizable ample.
proof: The two 25-word pieces have exact rational $1/240$-certificates. On their shared section, two common missing-pattern rows define a cycle ratio. The first piece forces that ratio below one and the second forces it above one. Any positive certificate of the union would therefore yield the impossible strict cycle $\alpha_2<\beta_-<\alpha_1<\beta_+<\alpha_2$.
